g.text: Square-wave matrix — 60 pairs, uniform and vertical-only scaling
Print order: row 1 at front, then rows 2–6 toward rear; left to right in every row.
10 layers: first 1 mm/s, fan OFF; layers 2–10 at 15 mm/s with selected 0% or 50% fan.
Spacing means vertical-step spacing. Labels below explicitly show step and full-cycle distances.
FRONT / Y0 — shaded corner is the printer exclusion area
Full build plate, top view (256 × 256 mm)
Geometry details at 1× baseline (0.3 mm vertical step)
Full crest-to-crest cycle = 2 × labeled spacing. Exact 1/3 scaling is used for 0.1 mm, rather than rounded 0.33.
Two mirrored lines per specimen. Tests 01–40: uniform scaling. Tests 41–60: vertical-only, fixed 0.6 / 1.0 mm horizontal bars.
Intro/outro stay 10 mm each. Width 0.15 mm; layer height 0.06 mm; total specimen height 0.60 mm.
Nozzle 245°C; bed 85°C; purge 20 mm/s; auxiliary fan OFF. All settings copied from uploaded matrix.
Model envelope: X30.69–219.46, Y20.00–244.90 mm. Transfer clearance Z1.00 mm.
Lines show nozzle centerlines; labels are not printed. Static validation passed; no physical printer test performed.
